svg.title: Residents use correction and appeal queues after the Hall's utility exception is reviewed.
svg.desc: Two orderly queues share a transfer point in Junction Square. The public register shows the occupied-site exception renewed through another limited review window. Cecil records a queue dispute, Ila orders the reason logged and the resident is allowed to move without losing their place.
svg.text: Page 61, panel 1 · Wide morning view of Junction Square's correction and appeal desks

text.tspan: At the scheduled ten o'clock review, Ila keeps the
occupied Hall supplied through a new limited window;
residents can correct and appeal without hiding why

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
